# v11 — a robust national release {#sec-release-v11}

```{r}
#| include: false
# The full chapter lives in releases/_v11-body.qmd (the leading underscore keeps
# Quarto from rendering it on its own). It renders in the v11 book, and in every
# book once the registry lists v11 as public. Until then a restricted release
# must never reach GitHub Pages (CLAUDE.md), so the public books of the other
# releases carry only the short note below, with no link to the review host.
# doc_access() fails closed for a version the published registry does not list.
v11_row    <- doc_version_row("v11")
v11_public <- nrow(v11_row) == 1 && !is.na(v11_row$ver[1]) &&
  identical(doc_access("v11"), "public")
v11_full   <- identical(doc_ver(), "v11") || v11_public
```

```{r}
#| label: v11-body
#| output: asis
if (v11_full) {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(
    here::here("releases/_v11-body.qmd"), quiet = TRUE, envir = environment()))
} else {
  cat(
"::: {.callout-note}
## A release under review

v11 is a pre-release under review. It keeps v10's two scores, within each ecoregion and across
the nation, and changes what goes into them: primary productivity integrated over the whole year,
our own distribution models for the sea turtles merged by the same rule as the species listed by
Distinct Population Segment, an occurrence rule that removes or down-weights a species where the
record does not place it, survey density models folded into the merge, and a merged value that
counts extinction risk once. Its chapter (each rule, the flags, which rule moved which score and
what moved in the Program-Area scores) is published with the v11 documentation on the signed-in
review host, and appears in every version of this book once v11 is released.
:::
")
}
```
